name: ServiceLayer
summary: A layer of services defining an application's boundary and the set of operations it offers.

roles.name: ServiceLayer
roles.summary: The boundary an application is called through. Each operation is one use case, and the layer carries the orchestration — transactions, security, calls to other systems — that no single domain object owns. What it must not carry is domain logic: a service layer that starts deciding things has hollowed out the model behind it.
